description: RepoReboot ’26 — i.Fest ’26 Hackathon RepoReboot ’26 is a hackathon organized by IEEE Student Branch DAIICT as part of i.Fest ’26. Participants will solve problem statements, develop innovative solutions, and demonstrate their working projects. Competition Format: Kick-off: Problem statements released on 21 October 2026 at 11:00 AM. PPT Submission: Teams submit their problem, idea, approach, and proposed solution by 5:00 PM on 21 October. Development: Teams implement their solutions. GitHub Submission: Submit the project repository by 12:00 AM on 22 October. Shortlisting: Top 15 teams are selected. Video Round: Shortlisted teams submit a 10-minute presentation and working demo video by 9:00 PM on 22 October. Final Judging: Winners are selected based on repository quality and video presentation. Evaluation Criteria: Code quality, project completeness, PPT clarity, working demo, and video explanation. Rules: Complete the official registration process. Read the rulebook and join the official WhatsApp group. Submit all deliverables before the deadlines. Ensure submitted links are accessible to evaluators. The coordinating committee’s decision regarding disputes will be final. Team size, eligibility, and inter-college participation will follow the organizing committee’s guidelines.
organiser: Dhirubhai Ambani Institute of Information and Communication Technology (DA-IICT), Gandhinagar

RepoReboot ’26 — i.Fest ’26 Hackathon

RepoReboot ’26 is a hackathon organized by IEEE Student Branch DAIICT as part of i.Fest ’26. Participants will solve problem statements, develop innovative solutions, and demonstrate their working projects.

Competition Format:

  • Kick-off: Problem statements released on 21 October 2026 at 11:00 AM.
  • PPT Submission: Teams submit their problem, idea, approach, and proposed solution by 5:00 PM on 21 October.
  • Development: Teams implement their solutions.
  • GitHub Submission: Submit the project repository by 12:00 AM on 22 October.
  • Shortlisting: Top 15 teams are selected.
  • Video Round: Shortlisted teams submit a 10-minute presentation and working demo video by 9:00 PM on 22 October.
  • Final Judging: Winners are selected based on repository quality and video presentation.

Evaluation Criteria: Code quality, project completeness, PPT clarity, working demo, and video explanation.

Rules:

  • Complete the official registration process.
  • Read the rulebook and join the official WhatsApp group.
  • Submit all deliverables before the deadlines.
  • Ensure submitted links are accessible to evaluators.
  • The coordinating committee’s decision regarding disputes will be final.

Team size, eligibility, and inter-college participation will follow the organizing committee’s guidelines.
